name: list-entry newline terminator
mechanism: Predicts the newline that closes a numbered map-key/index entry (name + grid code) so the next numbered entry can start, plus the analogous boundary in heading lists.

name: listing delimiter whitespace
mechanism: Predicts the stereotyped separator tokens inside guidebook listing lines - the space after a semicolon before the hours glyph 'h', entry-final newlines, and trailing grid digits.

name: repeated template completion
mechanism: Completes recurring local templates by matching earlier occurrences - map-grid digits after a coordinate letter, next place name in a heading run, and '( MAP GOOGLE MAP ) ;' boilerplate.

name: listing boilerplate punctuation
mechanism: Predicts low-entropy punctuation and whitespace slots in stereotyped listing formats (semicolon/space before hours, comma in population figures, entry-final newlines).

name: grid codes and caps labels
mechanism: Predicts the trailing map-grid digit after a coordinate letter and the continuation of all-caps venue-category labels (COCKTAIL BAR, LIVE MUSIC) at listing-name ends.

name: in-context name recall
mechanism: Retrieves the second token of multi-token names and fields already seen or strongly implied in context (Lamb & Flag, Guildhall, heading place names, '24' in h24hr).

name: name-conditioned label matching
mechanism: Predicts tokens dictated by the entity just named - the all-caps category echoing the name (Gardens->GARDENS, Cafe->CAFE, Guide->TOURIST), multi-token place-name continuations, and repeated population figures.

name: listing field-value tokens
mechanism: Predicts short digit/letter values in address and contact fields of listings - postcode digits, phone prefix '01', street numbers - plus entry-final newlines.

name: post-details paragraph break
mechanism: Predicts the newline after the closing parenthesis of a listing's details block, handing off from structured fields to the prose description that follows.

name: contents-list item continuation
mechanism: Continues table-of-contents style lists: the next '####' heading item, its terminating newline, and completions of index entry names (Gatwick, Activities, Allotment).

name: index entry tokens
mechanism: Predicts assorted tokens inside index/listing entries - heading items, caps label suffixes (TOURIST), grid digits, and the boilerplate space before 'MAP' - all copied from the recurring entry format.

name: next index item prediction
mechanism: Predicts the next item in enumerated indexes and heading lists - the following place/section name after '####' or the newline that starts the next numbered entry.

name: clause boundary before names
mechanism: Predicts connective words and punctuation at prose clause boundaries where the immediately following word is a proper name from the discourse (', Hinrichs', '. Once Cannizzaro', 'by the Canterbury West').

name: listing header line break
mechanism: Predicts the boundary ending a venue-name-plus-category header line (e.g. 'BOAT TOUR\n' before the '(' details line) and next items in heading lists.

name: map-key entry termination
mechanism: Predicts the newline closing numbered map-key entries ('29FabricC1\n') and completes the section labels (Entertainment, Shopping) heading those entry runs.

name: proper-name slot filling
mechanism: Retrieves proper-name tokens for stereotyped listing slots, most visibly tube-station names after the 't' transport glyph (tLeicester, tTottenham, tAldgate), plus grid digits and entry newlines.

name: section label completion
mechanism: Completes section and category labels in guidebook indexes - 'Top Sights', 'Shopping\n', caps venue types (PUB, WINE BAR) - and known multi-token entry names.

name: GOOGLE MAP boilerplate copy
mechanism: Predicts ' MAP' in the fixed '( MAP GOOGLE MAP ) ;' boilerplate by verbatim copy of the template repeated hundreds of times in the document.

name: caps label suffix completion
mechanism: Completes the tail of all-caps venue-type labels appended to names (HOTEL, MUSEUM, LANDMARK, THEATRE, CAFE) and of known multi-token place names (Chichester, Eastbourne).

name: mixed index and prose tokens
mechanism: Members split between index-entry tokens (Shopping, grid digits) and unrelated mid-sentence prose words; no single common function is evident.

name: listing address tokens
mechanism: Predicts tokens in address/detail fields of listings - postcode digits, street numbers ('8 High St'), field openers - together with index-entry newlines.

name: adult/child collocation
mechanism: Predicts 'child' after 'adult/' in admission-price fields - a fixed collocation in the listing format - plus a few other stereotyped compound completions (Larder, Hotspur).

name: detail-line field openers
mechanism: Predicts the delimiter or first token opening the next field in a listing detail line ('m'ains, ' tower'/';' before adult/, the space before the hours glyph).

name: guidebook structure tokens
mechanism: Predicts assorted format-determined tokens across guidebook structures - heading names, 'Top Sights', entry newlines, price-field abbreviations (s/d, r) - a broad parent of more specific children.

name: Sights heading completion
mechanism: Completes stereotyped section headings, dominantly '1Top Sights'/'1Sights', and the next place name in '###' heading sequences.

name: index name and label completion
mechanism: Completes index-entry names (Queen's Gallery, Shopping, Entertainment) and the trailing letters of caps venue labels (BAR, SHIP, STADIUM, PUB).

name: contents heading items
mechanism: Predicts the next place/section name in '####' table-of-contents runs and completions of index entry names, with terminating newlines.

name: next TOC heading prediction
mechanism: Predicts the place name of the next '####' table-of-contents heading (Rye, Dover, Battle, Sandwich, Hastings...), retrieving the geographically ordered list from context.

name: postcode digit completion
mechanism: Predicts the digit completing London postcodes in address fields (WC2, NW1, E1, SE1) after the district letters.

name: heading line terminator
mechanism: Predicts the newline ending '####' heading lines (Information, Tours, Entertainment, History) plus the ' MAP' boilerplate token.

name: index and heading tokens
mechanism: Broad parent covering format-determined tokens in guidebook indexes: grid digits, multi-token entry names (Hoxton Hotel, Jeake's House), heading items, and caps label endings.

name: map-key entry newline
mechanism: Predicts the newline terminating numbered map-key/index entries ('4Westminster AbbeyF3\n', '1Sights\n') so the next numbered item can begin.

name: curated list item names
mechanism: Predicts the next multi-token name in curated lists ('Best Places to Stay' hotel names, TOC section names like Eating/Shopping/Entertainment).

name: subsection heading recall
mechanism: Predicts short recurring subsection headings (Car, Bicycle, Toilets, Tourist Information) and repeated document figures like population numbers, recalled from parallel sections.

name: standard section sequence
mechanism: Predicts the next section name in the fixed guidebook chapter sequence (Sleeping, Eating, Drinking & Nightlife, Entertainment, Shopping, Information).

name: field separator semicolon
mechanism: Predicts the delimiter between fields of a listing detail line, chiefly the semicolon after the price range before the hours field, plus related in-field punctuation.

name: mains price-field opener
mechanism: Predicts the 'mains'/'s'/'d' abbreviation that opens the price field after an address in restaurant and hotel listings, plus table-number digits in the science text.

name: grid digits and index tokens
mechanism: Predicts trailing map-grid digits after coordinate letters (Clink78F2, GeneratorD3) mixed with index-entry completions and terminators.

name: guidebook heading tokens
mechanism: Predicts format-determined tokens around headings and labels - population figures after 'Pop', heading place names, caps label endings (CLUB, HOTEL, HOSTEL) - a broad parent pack.
